name: Rocco Arena, b. 20 December 1861
father: Francesco Antonio Arena, 42, marinaro, son of Filippo
note: ACT READ IN FULL. Declared 23 December 1861 at Scilla, Distretto di Reggio, by the father himself. Witnesses Giuseppe Idone, 64, and Francesco Antonio Poli, 70, proprietario. The parish note records the baptism of Rocco Arena on the 23rd. Gives THREE generations: Filippo Arena, his son Francesco Antonio (b. c.1819, a SAILOR), and Rocco.
